text:
marco: quick question — who owns the final routing decision for tenant requests: the SDK (client-side hints) or the Console/policy engine (server-side)? we
need clarity before we start the quota attribution/dashboard changes.

Tess: i think we discussed this briefly but no final call. my concern: if SDKs start making authoritative routing choices, the Console won't be able to show accurate per-policy metrics without additional reporting.

alicia: product POV: console should remain the source-of-truth for policy config. that said, clients can provide hints for perf optimization but they must be non-authoritative by default.

sam: runtime notes: we already support fallback routing when a model is unavailable. adding client authoritative routing would complicate SLOs + fallbacks. also impacts KV cache locality.

pj: from SDK compatibility side, any change that makes clients authoritative is a breaking change. we could add an opt-in flag in vX+1.

marco: proposal: introduce a 3-way negotiation header: `X-Redwood-Route-Mode: server|client|hybrid` where server is default. SDKs can opt-in to client or hybrid. server honors client hint iff mode=hybrid or client and matches policy constraints.

ken: +1 for explicit header. also we need to surface this on Console: a dashboard tile showing percent of traffic using client-delegation vs server.

Tess: UX follow-ups: console needs a rollout toggle per-tenant that allows *allow client delegation* (off by default). admins should be able to revoke per-route.

alicia: agree. this solves product + security concerns. but it means quota attribution might change (if client routes to cheaper region/model). we need a mapping plan so billing doesn't surprise customers.

sam: telemetry implications: we should emit events when delegation happens: `route.delegated` with fields: `mode`, `chosen_node`, `policy_id` (if matched or null). also include sampling so we don't blow up traces.

pj: SDK rollout plan: default behaviour unchanged (server). Add new API: `client.setRoutingDelegate(true)` and header injection in SDK requests when enabled. We'll gate with feature flag and document in changelog.

marco: code sketch for header we can use in SDKs:

```
// client request
headers["X-Redwood-Route-Mode"] = "hybrid"; // "server" by default
body.route = { "hint": "latency-first", "ttl": 600 }
```

marco: server side pseudocode:

```
if (header.mode == "client") {
  if (!tenantConfig.allowClientDelegation) reject();
  else acceptClientChoice();
} else if (header.mode == "hybrid") {
  acceptClientHintIfSafe();
} else {
  evaluateServerPolicy();
}
```

Tess: for the Console dashboard, we should add a new telemetry metric: `redwood.routing.delegate_pct` with `tenant` and `route` tags. a small tile that shows trend + top delegated policies.

ken: agree. also add a delta chart showing any cost difference introduced by delegation vs server-chosen routing. that helps CS and finance.

alicia: legal/security note: delegation must not leak tenant-internal routing metadata. we need to scrub any path-level identifiers from client hints.

sam: implementational detail: when accepting client hint, runtime must still decide fallback order and maintain SLO guarantees. client-provided choice is advisory unless tenantConfig.forceClientRouting true (enterprise only).

pj: migration: SDKs will ship v3.2 with the flag but off by default. devex to prepare migration guide and code samples. we should create a compatibility test in our CI that simulates both modes.

devex-bot: CI job created: `sdk-routing-delegation-compat` — runs unit + integration tests against staging runtime (owner: pj).

marco: action items:
- pj: add header support & SDK opt-in API (owner)
- sam: add route.delegated telemetry event + sampling plan (owner)
- tess: Console toggle UI + telemetry tile spec (owner)
- ken: cost-delta dashboard + finance signals (owner)
- alicia: write migration policy for customers + billing note (owner)

pj: i'll start a branch this week. estimate 2 sprints for SDK + tests.

sam: i'll add telemetry events with 1% sampling by default; can ramp up if debugging.

Tess: i'll sketch the Console tile and the per-tenant toggle mockups, will post screenshots in a follow-up thread.

alicia: if no objections by EOD tomorrow, i'll add to the next release notes and signal to account teams. :thumbsup:

marco: thanks all. minor follow-up: are we okay with the header name? `X-Redwood-Route-Mode` vs `X-RW-Route-Mode`? shorter is nicer in SDKs.

pj: prefer `X-RW-Route-Mode` to reduce header length, but fine either way. we'll normalize in SDKs.

ken: please add an event `route.mode_header` to telemetry so we can backfill logs when debugging.

marco: cool. leaving this open for +1s. if you want to be an explicit reviewer, ping me.
